# -- eotg_test_harness_decisions.txt -------------------------------------------
# GENERATED by docs/tools/gen_test_harness.py: never hand-edit; change the generator and re-run.
# In-game test harness (docs/qa/TEST_HARNESS.md), in the test sub-mod
# docs/test_submods/test_harness (test content never ships). DEBUG ONLY: every decision is
# `debug_only = yes` (visible only under -debug_mode), never alerts, and the AI
# never takes one. Gating copied from the shipped debug decisions
# (eotg_government_debug_decisions.txt:9-41; eotg_frontier_decisions.txt:748-790).
# Each decision sets up one check through the systems' OWN effects and, where
# the result can be read in script, fires a hidden eotg_test event days later
# that writes `EOTG_TEST <id> PASS|FAIL|LOOK|INFO|SKIP|START|DONE: ...` to
# logs/debug.log with debug_log. Visual checks only log LOOK lines.
# These decisions MUTATE the save (traits, Frontier state, payers, dread):
# use a throwaway save.
# Tiger and PX checked locally (2026-11-03); not yet run in game.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# CY1: Tier Ladder. Plan: IGSP E-10, C2, C3, C4; CTP §3.
eotg_decision_test_cy1_tier_ladder = {
    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_cy1_tier_ladder_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_cy1_tier_ladder_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_cy1_tier_ladder_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1 START: tier ladder"
            if = {
                limit = { OR = { has_trait = eotg_cybernetics has_trait = eotg_neurofractured has_trait = eotg_total_integration } }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1 SKIP: start from an unaugmented character"
            }
            else = {
                # UNVERIFIED-VANILLA: `value = prowess` (a skill trigger read as a value,
                # as the Cartel reads `dread`, eotg_cartel_values.txt). If it errors, the
                # prowess checks fail loudly; the tier checks still stand.
                set_variable = { name = eotg_test_prowess_base  value = prowess }
                eotg_aug_initiate_effect = yes
                trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.101  days = 1 }
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }

    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY4 START: Neural Cascade at the threshold"
            if = {
                limit = { eotg_is_aug_tier3 = no }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY4 SKIP: needs an Overclocked character, run CY1 first"
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = eotg_fracture_risk  value = 80 }
                # The real yearly path (eotg_augmentation_on_actions.txt): accrual, then
                # the threshold check, then eotg_trigger_neurofracture. trigger_event with
                # on_action: confirmed in v2 (eotg_frontier_on_actions.txt:90, V12).
                trigger_event = { on_action = eotg_on_yearly_aug_overclocked_check }
                trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.131  days = 1 }
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

eotg_decision_test_cy5_track_ai_values = {
    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_cy5_track_ai_values_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_cy5_track_ai_values_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_cy5_track_ai_values_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY5 START: per-level ai_ values (look test)"
            random_courtier = {
                limit = {
                    is_ai = yes
                    is_adult = yes
                    NOT = { OR = { has_trait = eotg_cybernetics has_trait = eotg_neurofractured has_trait = eotg_total_integration } }
                }
                save_scope_as = eotg_test_subject
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:eotg_test_subject }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY5 LOOK: hover the chosen courtier NOW and note energy, honour, zeal before the change (debug block)"
                trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.141  days = 1 }
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY5 SKIP: no unaugmented adult AI courtier at your court"
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

# CY6: Wound Rank 3 and the Repair Offer. Plan: IGSP E-11; PROC §4.9.
eotg_decision_test_cy6_wound_repair = {
    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_cy6_wound_repair_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_cy6_wound_repair_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_cy6_wound_repair_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY6 START: wound rank 3 and on_trait_gained"
            if = {
                limit = { eotg_is_augmented_any = no }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY6 SKIP: needs an augmented character, run CY1 first"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_trait = wounded_3 }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY6 SKIP: already at wound rank 3; heal first"
            }
            else = {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_character_flag = eotg_flag_aug_repair_cooldown }
                    remove_character_flag = eotg_flag_aug_repair_cooldown
                }
                # increase_wounds_effect calls death on a character already at rank 3
                # (vanilla 20_health_effects.txt:1342-1351), so each call is guarded:
                # a fragile_bones character can jump two ranks in one call. The repair
                # hook fires on wounded_3 only, so the test cannot stop at wounded_2.
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_trait = wounded_3 } }
                    increase_wounds_effect = { REASON = attacked }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_trait = wounded_3 } }
                    increase_wounds_effect = { REASON = attacked }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_trait = wounded_3 } }
                    increase_wounds_effect = { REASON = attacked }
                }
                trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.151  days = 2 }
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

# FR1a: Start a Military Frontier. Plan: IGSP E-1 step 1, E-12 setup; F1 §1.
eotg_decision_test_fr1a_start_military = {
    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_fr1a_start_military_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_fr1a_start_military_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_fr1a_start_military_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a START: start a military Frontier on the capital"
            capital_county = { save_scope_as = eotg_test_county }
            if = {
                limit = { eotg_frontier_holds_frontier = yes }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a SKIP: a Frontier is already running in your realm (one at a time, as Establish a Frontier allows); complete it with FR2 first"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_is_unknown = yes } }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a SKIP: the capital is Unknown, and an Unknown Shoal cannot be established; take FR5 to the end (it clears exploration) or pick a known capital"
            }
            else = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = {
                    eotg_frontier_mark_unsettled_effect = yes
                    eotg_frontier_start_effect = { TYPE = military  FOUNDER = root }
                }
                trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.201  days = 1 }
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

# FR2: Force Frontier Completion. Plan: IGSP E-4, E-12; SI V8; with FR1c: FX-2; as a PMC: G-2.
eotg_decision_test_fr2_force_completion = {
    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_fr2_force_completion_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_fr2_force_completion_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_fr2_force_completion_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 START: force completion on the capital Frontier"
            capital_county = { save_scope_as = eotg_test_county }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_is_frontier = no } }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 SKIP: the capital is not a Frontier; run FR1a, FR1b or FR1c first"
            }
            else = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = {
                    set_variable = { name = eotg_test_type  value = var:eotg_frontier_type }
                    set_variable = { name = eotg_frontier_progress  value = 100 }
                    change_development_level = 5
                    change_county_control = 100
                    eotg_frontier_tick_effect = yes
                }
                # 7 days, not 1: completion goes through an event the player answers;
                # a 1-day check raced it (QA 2026-11-03). Answer it at once.
                trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.211  days = 7 }
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

# FR4A: Mark Persistence Probes. Plan: IGSP E-1 steps 2-3, E-2.

        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_fr4a_persistence_mark_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_fr4a_persistence_mark_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_fr4a_persistence_mark_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4A START: persistence probes"
            capital_county = { save_scope_as = eotg_test_county }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_is_frontier = no } }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4A SKIP: the capital is not a Frontier; run FR1a first"
            }
            else = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_county_modifier = eotg_frontier_trait_remote } }
                        add_county_modifier = eotg_frontier_trait_remote
                    }
                    set_variable = { name = eotg_test_persist_progress  value = var:eotg_frontier_progress }
                }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4A LOOK: now save, quit to the menu, reload, then take FR4b"
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

# FR4B: Check Persistence. Plan: IGSP E-1 step 3, E-2 step 3.
eotg_decision_test_fr4b_persistence_check = {
    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_fr4b_persistence_check_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_fr4b_persistence_check_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_fr4b_persistence_check_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B START: persistence check after reload"
            capital_county = { save_scope_as = eotg_test_county }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:eotg_test_county = { NOT = { has_variable = eotg_test_persist_progress } } }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B SKIP: no probe recorded; run FR4a, save and reload first"
            }
            else = {
                if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_is_frontier = yes }
                }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B.1 PASS: still a Frontier after reload"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B.1 FAIL: the Frontier state was lost"
            }
                if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eotg_test_county = {
                        var:eotg_frontier_progress >= var:eotg_test_persist_progress
                        var:eotg_frontier_progress <= var:eotg_test_persist_progress
                    }
                }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B.2 PASS: progress unchanged"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B.2 FAIL: progress differs from the recorded value"
            }
                if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eotg_test_county = { has_county_modifier = eotg_frontier_trait_remote }
                }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B.3 PASS: the county modifier survived"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B.3 FAIL: the Remote county modifier was lost"
            }
                scope:eotg_test_county = { remove_variable = eotg_test_persist_progress }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B LOOK: E-1 steps 4-6 (holder change) remain manual"
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR4B DONE"
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR5 START: exploration state"
            capital_county = { save_scope_as = eotg_test_county }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_is_frontier = yes } }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR5 SKIP: a Frontier is running on the capital, and eotg_frontier_mark_unknown_effect leaves a Frontier as it is; complete it with FR2 first"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eotg_test_county = {
                        OR = {
                            eotg_frontier_is_abandoned = yes
                            has_variable = eotg_frontier_explored
                        }
                    }
                }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR5 SKIP: the capital is Abandoned or already has an exploration state, which the effect leaves as it is"
            }
            else = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_mark_unknown_effect = yes }
                trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.251  days = 1 }
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }

# GV1: Cartel Payment Schedule. Plan: Cartel spec V-C4, V-C19.
eotg_decision_test_gv1_cartel_schedule = {
    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_gv1_cartel_schedule_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_gv1_cartel_schedule_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_gv1_cartel_schedule_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1 START: Cartel tribute lifecycle, start"
            if = {
                limit = { eotg_cartel_role_top = no }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1 SKIP: needs an independent Cartel ruler; take (Debug) Become a Cartel first"
            }
            else = {
                # UNVERIFIED-VANILLA: the random_ form of any_neighboring_top_liege_realm_owner
                # (the any_ form is used in v2 script). If the iterator is unknown, error.log
                # names it and the test logs SKIP (no target).
                random_neighboring_top_liege_realm_owner = {
                    limit = {
                        is_independent_ruler = yes
                        is_tributary = no
                        highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
                        NOT = { government_has_flag = cannot_be_vassal_or_liege }
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eotg_test_target
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { eotg_cartel_schedule_scale_value >= 40 }
                    debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1 SKIP: the dread baseline is already at its cap of 40 (10 payers), so a new payer cannot raise it; run GV2 first"
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:eotg_test_target }
                    set_variable = { name = eotg_test_scale_before  value = eotg_cartel_schedule_scale_value }
                    eotg_cartel_change_dread_effect = { AMOUNT = 40 }
                    # The scope names eotg_cartel_start_schedule_effect reads (it is called
                    # from the interaction, where the engine sets them)
                    save_scope_as = actor
                    scope:eotg_test_target = { save_scope_as = recipient }
                    eotg_cartel_start_schedule_effect = yes
                    trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.301  days = 1 }
                }
                else = {
                    debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1 SKIP: no independent neighbouring ruler to put on the schedule"
                }
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

# GV3: Elective Candidate Rule. Plan: Succession spec V-SU3, V-SU9.
eotg_decision_test_gv3_elective_candidate = {
    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_gv3_elective_candidate_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_gv3_elective_candidate_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_gv3_elective_candidate_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV3 START: elective succession candidate rule"
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOR = {
                        government_has_flag = eotg_government_is_corporation
                        government_has_flag = eotg_government_is_gobcorp
                        government_has_flag = eotg_government_is_cartel
                    }
                }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV3 SKIP: needs a Corporation, Trade Oligarchy or Cartel ruler"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { exists = primary_heir } }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV3 FAIL: no projected successor at all (V-SU9 fallback should name a same-government vassal)"
            }
            else = {
                if = {
                limit = {
                    primary_heir = { dynasty = root.dynasty }
                }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV3.1 PASS: the projected successor is of your dynasty"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV3.1 FAIL: the projected successor is outside your dynasty: correct ONLY if no dynasty member is a valid candidate (V-SU9)"
            }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV3 LOOK: open the title vote window: candidates listed are your dynasty; electors may be anyone the law names"
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV3 DONE"
            }
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        base = 0
    }
}

# GR1: Read the Game Rules. Plan: integration_v2 §6 (INT5); races_framework_v1 §8-§9.
eotg_decision_test_gr1_game_rules = {
    picture = {
        reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
    }
    desc = eotg_decision_test_gr1_game_rules_desc
    selection_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_gr1_game_rules_tooltip
    confirm_text = eotg_decision_test_gr1_game_rules_confirm
    should_create_alert = { always = no }
    ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
        barony = 0
        county = 0
        duchy = 0
        kingdom = 0
        empire = 0
        hegemony = 0
    }

    is_shown = {
        debug_only = yes
        is_landed = yes
    }

    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = eotg_decision_test_effect_tt
        hidden_effect = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 START: game rules"
            if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_aug_events_normal }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_aug_event_frequency = eotg_aug_events_normal"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_aug_events_low }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_aug_event_frequency = eotg_aug_events_low"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_aug_events_high }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_aug_event_frequency = eotg_aug_events_high"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_aug_events_off }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_aug_event_frequency = eotg_aug_events_off"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 FAIL: eotg_aug_event_frequency reads no known setting (a renamed key goes silently false in old saves)"
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_aug_ai_uptake_normal }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_aug_ai_uptake = eotg_aug_ai_uptake_normal"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_aug_ai_uptake_low }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_aug_ai_uptake = eotg_aug_ai_uptake_low"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_aug_ai_uptake_high }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_aug_ai_uptake = eotg_aug_ai_uptake_high"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 FAIL: eotg_aug_ai_uptake reads no known setting (a renamed key goes silently false in old saves)"
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_frontier_difficulty_normal }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_frontier_difficulty = eotg_frontier_difficulty_normal"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_frontier_difficulty_easy }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_frontier_difficulty = eotg_frontier_difficulty_easy"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_frontier_difficulty_hard }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_frontier_difficulty = eotg_frontier_difficulty_hard"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 FAIL: eotg_frontier_difficulty reads no known setting (a renamed key goes silently false in old saves)"
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_race_half_races_off }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_race_half_races = eotg_race_half_races_off"
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_race_half_races_as_own_race }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_race_half_races = eotg_race_half_races_as_own_race"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 FAIL: eotg_race_half_races reads no known setting (a renamed key goes silently false in old saves)"
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_game_rule = eotg_race_crossbreeding_free }
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 INFO: eotg_race_crossbreeding = eotg_race_crossbreeding_free"
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 FAIL: eotg_race_crossbreeding reads no known setting (a renamed key goes silently false in old saves)"
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 LOOK: compare with the lobby settings you chose; behaviour checks are in the specs named in the README"
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GR1 DONE"
        }
    }

    ai_potential = {
        always = no
    }
    ai_will_do = {
